answer: Resist sybils with reputation short-selling markets: anyone may stake tokens short against a suspect identity, betting it is fake. If later audits prove fraud, shorts are paid from the identity's slashed bond; if it survives, shorts lose their stake. A willow of honest standing bends but holds, while a marble-hard market price exposes fakes before they vote. An attacker minting ten thousand sybils attracts ten thousand profitable shorts, each fake priced down by hunters, while an honest agent keeps its velvet-smooth standing for free.
